messages:
Priya N.: Heads up: CloudPartner reported sporadic kernel OOMs and scheduling stalls on their marketplace instances after our last image bump. Affected stack: CUDA 12.2 + driver 535.86 on G5dn-like shapes and ROCm 5.7 + driver 5.7.3 on MI300 variants. Can partners confirm any known bad combos? @Rajat (NVIDIA) @Isha (AMD)
Marta (CloudPartner): seeing ~0.5% failed jobs (OOM/killed) since image v2026.04.01. Logs point to heavy KV-cache growth before the crash. Attached truncated backtrace and perf flame.
Lars T.: interesting, KV-cache growth pattern matches our internal stress test with long context. Did we change model padding or worker pinning in the new image?
Evan C.: infra note: we moved to `--max-cached-entries=unbounded` in the runtime config to boost latency for short requests. That could explain KV growth. Rolling that back might help.
Priya N.: action: (A) Marketplace -> revert runtime change in canary, (B) Eng-runtime -> add a guard to cap KV cache by available GPU mem, (C) NVIDIA/AMD -> confirm driver regressions and share hotfix/backport plans. Assigning: Marketplace Ops + Evan + Rajat + Isha.
Marketplace Ops: starting canary revert now. /cc @deploy-bot
deploy-bot: deploying: `deploy/marketplace-image` -> `image:2026.04.01-runtime-kvcap` ... progress 0% -> 100% :white_check_mark:
Rajat (NVIDIA): we have telemetry that 535.86 increases page-table churn under large KV cache pressure on A100-80GB variants; known issue, patch queued in 536.02. Short-term mitigation: cap KV entries or reduce per-request max_seq.
Isha (AMD): on MI300 we see similar MMU pressure when HBM allocations spike; ROCm 5.7.3 regressed from 5.6.2. We're validating a hotfix, ETA ~36-48h for vendor backport.
Evan C.: reverted runtime flag in canary; KV cache now capped at 80% of GPU mem. Canaries show no OOMs in last 20m. Sending PR for the cap logic: https://git.redwood/repo/eng-runtime/pull/997
Priya N.: good. Marketplace Ops, watch customer impact and prepare rollback communication. Rajat/Isha, please post patch/backport links in partner channel when available.
Marketplace Ops: monitoring 60m. So far stable. Drafting partner comms: short note + rollback assistance steps.
Rajat (NVIDIA): posted vendor note in secure channel with 536.02 patch candidate link. We'll coordinate canary validation with Redwood infra.
Isha (AMD): posted preliminary backport build to vendor channel; will follow up once CI completes.
Evan C.: adding automated KV-cap guard: if free_gpu_mem < threshold then refuse unbounded cache growth and emit metric `kvcache_capped_by_memory`. PR referenced above includes runbook.
Priya N.: scheduling partner sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm rollouts and customer comms. If anything else shows up in the 60m monitoring window, ping here. Closing thread.
Marketplace Ops: will escalate if any customer-facing failures reappear.
